description: Full 24-month (2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31) synthetic QuestShelf evaluation dataset containing shelf status transitions, play sessions, completions, ratings, drop reasons, friend library additions, and 26 co-op polls. Recommended virtual_now >= 2026-12-31T23:00:00-08:00.

sources.description: 100% synthetic 2-year user game-library activity, friend library additions, and co-op poll history generated deterministically by scripts/build-eval-dataset.cjs (no scraped store data or real personal data).

transformations: Validated against schemas/seed.schema.json and plugin.validateSeed chronological invariants.

review.notes: 100% synthetic evaluation dataset verified across all 24 months (2025-01..2026-12) via scripts/coverage.cjs and real stdio MCP env.load_seed.
